opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation; UK citizens or EEA nationals; early‑career postdoctoral researchers with doctorate completed between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships for early‑career researchers to pursue an independent research project leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, with a permanent or fixed‑term position, able to lead interdisciplinary collaborations across the Academies.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research awards of up to 24 months to address societal challenges.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers in the humanities or social sciences, at any career stage, proposing public‑engagement projects with a GLAM or performing‑arts partner.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects that connect research with audiences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation, across all career stages, seeking to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities or language skills.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support skill‑development and methodological innovation for UK researchers.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences, with at least 20 % FTE commitment, collaborating with overseas co‑applicants across any SHAPE or STEM discipline.
opportunities.summary: Funding for 24‑month interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, involving international partners.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑ or mid‑career UK‑based researchers in the humanities or social sciences, able to spend at least 20 % of time on the fellowship, working at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships to develop policy‑relevant research and networks in partnership with DGAP.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (exceptionally higher amounts may be considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months, who need support for equipment, caring costs, accessibility or application assistance.
opportunities.summary: Up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible) to cover additional needs of award‑holders or applicants.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the UK, employed by a UK university or research organisation; independent scholars may also apply.
opportunities.summary: Small research grants of up to £10,000 for projects of up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Funding for early‑career scholars to attend a research collaboration symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’, with travel and accommodation covered.
